headline: Monterey County District Attorney’s Office warns residents about new fraud schemes, urges reporting
summary: MONTEREY COUNTY — Monterey County District Attorney’s Office is warning residents and businesses about several fraud schemes circulating in the county, including fake government invoices, scams involving supposedly compromised financial accounts and real estate title fraud.
source: King City Rustler / South County Newspapers
